Crafter, Dubai Immo and Beauld As Brass all have fair chances in a wide open affair

selections.comment: A lot hinges on whether or not Knockout Blow returns from a 674 day absence in anything like the same shape as when last seen scoring a course and distance double. He's greatly feared and the market should offer some clues as to his well-being but on balance it's probably best to look elsewhere. It's tight between Big Bard and Just Ten High, with the former just edging preference of these two given less to forgive last time but they might have to settle for minor honiurs as HARRY BROWN gets the nod. His latest effort can be excused when unable to get a position early from a poor draw and left with too much to do despite travelling well in the rear. The handicapper has given him a real chance with a further 2lb drop given a narrow defeat (under a length) when third over CD in early March in a class 5 handicap. Phoenix Moon is an obvious danger but looks vulnerable off a 4lb rise. Unavailable will be seen to much better effect over now returned to six furlongs having struggled badly over 5f the last thrice

Course specialist Parisencore has a lay off to overcome but could stay into a place if getting a stiff test. Nettywell returned to form in a strong race last time off his reduced mark and is entitled to be thereabouts once more if handling the quicker ground

She could get an easy lead here and may prove tough to peg back if that is the case. Feach Amach was an easy winner last time and ought to remain competitive despite a 12lb rise in the weights. Bishop Hill hinted at a revival last time and is entitled to come on for the run. She could run into a place if doing so.

selections.comment: This looks a match race between JACKPOT DES BORDES and Handlethekettle. The latter's maiden win has been franked and he was thought well enough to contest a Graded race next time so is heavily respected dropping in class. However he may just need this run after a wind op and may be vulnerable to his race fit rival. The selection was too keen in a good handicap last time but the headgear is removed and he's entitled to come on for that run. The form of his previous defeat has been franked and if matching that he should go close.

She is feared along with the unexposed and steadily progressive Jacksbar who conceded first run to an in form rival last time.

selections.comment: LARA KALEO has placed both start over hurdles so far and can take advantage of a lenient opening mark here. Her debut effort has been franked in a hot Cheltenham handicap and she is open to further progress now upped in trip. Jukebox Annie is already a fast ground course winner and was far from disgraced in a better race last time. She may be up to defying top weight here. The inconsistent Bruce Gobbler found 2m too sharp here last time and looks a potential improver now upped in distance. He could complete the places.

selections.comment: An open race where TARITINO may be able to follow up on his last time out C&D win. He showed a good turn of foot and a willing attitude that day and will be tough to catch if alllowed a similarly easy lead. He was chased home by Galatic Glow that day and that rival may be able to get close if ridden slightly more positively. Jo's Rainbow's form tailed off in the autumn but she has dropped to an attractive mark on her flat form. Back from a break following a wind op, she holds each way claims.
